services.name: Recreational Cheer
services.desc: Our Rec Cheer class is run by the session instead of monthly. The FALL 2026 session will run SEPTEMBER 19 - DECEMBER 12 (12 classes). The focus will be to learn and practice the components of a cheer routine, putting it all together to show friends and family at the end of the session. This fun 75 minute class for 6-12 yrs will explore beginner aspects of recreational cheerleading, including stunting, jumps and tumbling. It will be instructed by some of our awesome coaches that did (or still do) cheer. (No experience needed!) services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Then you will move on up to our birthday party room for 45-60 minutes to enjoy food, cake and gifts! If your child is sick on the day of their party, please let us know as early as you can. You will be given the option to re-book. If you need to cancel the party for a different reason, we must have at least 7 days notice in order to receive a refund (minus a $15 admin fee). Cancelations made with less than 7 days notice are not eligible for a refund. Guests are required to have an online waiver on file before participating in any activities at SGC. services.desc: The Strathmore Silhouettes coaches are dedicated to helping each competitive athlete to achieve their personal best. Every athlete learns differently, and at a different rate. Our aim is to promote physical, mental and emotional strength, thus awarding the athlete with a sense of accomplishment, which can radiate into many areas of their lives. Through making realistic and attainable goals, dedication and hard work, our athletes gain many benefits; self confidence, hard work ethic, discipline, courage, determination, perseverance, focus and concentration, friendships, sportsmanship....to name a few.
